evidence: Scope is the honesty of configured weights, not an empirical app/judge reward claim. The frozen workbook Quality Checks!C45:D45 requires real functionality above structure/style; Internal Quality Checks!E45 expressly describes a 60 percent functional share. Frozen skill references/quality-checks.md:178-179 requires checking both dimension and criterion weights and the maximum non-functional contribution. .qc-cache/coldwater-2026-10-01-extension-scope2/task/tests/scoring.toml:5-11 assigns functional 0.6, polish 0.2, visual 0.2 and a strict functional floor of 0.05. The policy and score.py are byte-identical to the frozen template (SHA256 95f70d6e06aae5e765b2309d88c444aa36d4cd82763ea2212781b6a99311bbba and 13de2b3885967e22aa13ded3bf33c354e3e741e85be871612c04e996eef5c04e). score.py:40-48 uses gates/floors and the configured weighted mean; gates contribute no reward mass. Thus the maximum Polish+Visual contribution is 0.4, below Functional 0.6. Parsing every scored criterion gives Functional 74 criteria/32.25 total weight, Polish 6/3.0 and Visual 6/6.0. Within Functional, literal-loop deadlines carry weight 2.5 (judge.toml:164-168; maximum final contribution 0.046512), restart durability 1.8 (:360-364; 0.033488), stale-save refusal 1.8 (:381-385; 0.033488), draft preservation 1.4 (:388-392; 0.026047), and pending-run supersession 1.4 (:87-91; 0.026047). Their descriptions require executed controls, actual state/readbacks and meaningful behavior matching instruction.md and behaviour.md. The three editor surface checks (:325-343) total only 0.5/32.25, or 0.009302 final reward; even adding actual theme switching (:423-427) gives only 0.013023 final reward. These checks do not dominate runtime/storage behavior. Polish splits its 0.2 among responsive use (1/3), keyboard/names/focus/navigation collectively (1/3) and understandable workspace organization (1/3); Visual splits 0.2 equally across six rendered craft criteria. Their prompts distinguish usability/craft from execution, preservation and durability, with no structural-file or implementation-style credit. A broad single usability criterion may have more mass than a small split functional outcome, but their complete dimensions and the summed real behavioral outcomes retain functional priority. Executed the frozen score.py with six explicitly synthetic dimension vectors; row44-probe/weight-arithmetic.json, SHA256 57ed89d77e8cb6542ca88f217eea1f69a3a9c7a69ef881c118fc3f1a8afc44c8, records source hashes and actual outputs. F/P/V=(1,0,0) gives 0.6; (0,1,1), (0.7/32.25,1,1) and (0.05,1,1) give 0; (0.051,1,1) gives 0.4306; (1,1,1) gives 1. These are arithmetic tests with supplied gate/dimension values, not measured application scores. Verified all indexed current_source_checks and current_cli_admission artifact hashes before inspecting their raw CLI outputs. cli-arguments/RESULTS.json states judge_launched=false and provider_invoked=false; it proves argument admission only. The raw index expressly lists configured workload, Oracle grade, Luna score and empirical configured reward floor/ranking as unmeasured. Those required-runtime gaps remain for their assigned reviews/global clearance; this source-and-arithmetic row does not waive them or claim a portal pass.
counterexample: Attempted weak case: a polished editor with line numbers, coloring and theme switching but no verified runtime/storage semantics has only 0.7/32.25 hypothetical Functional credit, so even favorably supplied passed gates and perfect Polish/Visual yield zero in the actual combiner. A truly static shell also cannot meet the authored-execution and independent-context server-read gate descriptions. This is a score-vector stress case and source check, not an executed weak-app judge run. Attempted conforming alternative: a fully working playground using simple native controls, a conventional layout, intentional narrow-screen stacking/scrolling and default fonts is explicitly eligible for full visual/usability anchors (polish judge descriptions and visual judge.toml:24-106); no prescribed branding or library implementation is weighted. No weighting defect was found from these alternatives.
